summary: Frontend-only regression covering (1) device-language default + persistence on onboarding screen, (2) new Home 'explore-map' card for CLIENT role, (3) /map with radius chips 2/5/10/20/50 + category filter + Stars/TrustChip/ActivePill on every card, (4) business-request geocoding fields and successful order placement, (5) regression on the Fase 3 order flow. Login page renders in ENGLISH by default (browser locale en-US) with IT/EN toggle at the top-right; switching to IT shows 'Accedi'/'Bentornato' and PERSISTS across full reload. Injecting session token disp-test-token-777 lands on the CLIENT Home which shows the 'Search around you' explore-map card; tapping it opens /map. On /map the radius chips reload results (radius 2 → 2 cards, radius 50 → 3 cards; strictly increasing). Every provider/business card renders Stars rating, Trust Score chip and Active pill (only 'Active' present because backend /providers/nearby now returns online-only, per product decision). Category filter cat-pulizie narrows to 2 cards and cat-all restores full list. Business-request screen for Francesco Franzin (user_2f996c8a010a, category=lavanderia) shows testIDs breq-address + breq-location; placing an order (+1 Lavaggio camicia) with a manually typed address succeeded (server-side geocoded) and the success screen 'Order sent! Amount held in escrow' rendered. No red screens, no uncaught errors, only benign shadow*/pointerEvents web deprecation warnings.

integration_issues.issue: Logging in with these credentials lands on the PROVIDER Home (title 'Missions', online toggle, 'Incoming requests', no explore-map card). Per test_credentials.md and the review request, this account should be role=client. Only the injected client token (disp-test-token-777) actually reached the client Home with the explore-map card. Not blocking (the review allows OR-fallback via injection), but the client email account role appears mis-seeded/toggled.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' fires on multiple screens. Explicitly accepted by product note, but should be migrated eventually.

Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' fires from the client Home floating action wrapper (index.tsx floatWrap style block already uses pointerEvents in the style prop – runtime still complains, likely from another wrapper). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:191.

action_items: Verify why bstest@jobby.app / test1234 renders the provider Home instead of the client Home (role in DB may have flipped to provider after previous sprints). Either re-seed to client or update /app/memory/test_credentials.md to reflect actual role.
(Nice-to-have) Track down the residual pointerEvents deprecation warning and migrate shadow* to boxShadow for web build hygiene.
critical_code_review_comments: map.tsx correctly wires api.providersNearby(lat,lng,category,radius) with a useEffect dependency on [center.lat, center.lng, category, radiusKm] – reloads happen as expected.

business-request/[businessId].tsx resolveCoords() only overrides coords when geocode succeeds and !fallback – good; falls back to previous coords otherwise so the order still succeeds even if geocoding fails.
LanguageContext.tsx defaults to device locale (it→it, everything else→en) and is overridden by persisted 'jobby_lang' key – matches product decision.
seed_data_creation: None – used existing seeded Francesco Franzin catalog and disp-test-token-777 client wallet.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Prefer session-token injection (localStorage 'jobby_session_token' = JSON.stringify('disp-test-token-777')) to reach the CLIENT Home reliably; the bstest email account currently boots the provider Home. Map screen returns 3 online near Treviso within 50 km (2 within 2 km). API /providers/nearby now returns online-only, so 'Inactive' pills will not appear on /map in current data.
rca_of_issue: n/a – all requested features verified working.
